normalization.area: Public effective areas; sum A; physical scale S=sqrt(A)
normalization.local: s_i=sqrt(a_i); reference-position and boundary scale t_i=max(s_i,0.5*median(s))
normalization.penetration: sum over unique i<j of (minimum-axis translation depth/s_ij)^2, divided by N
normalization.wire: Exact weighted centroid Manhattan b2b+p2b sum divided by S*(sum b2b weights+sum p2b weights); zero if no positive weights
normalization.compactness: relu(predicted bbox area/A-1); never reads reference bbox
normalization.group: Sum of predicted-geometry MST contact costs across public groups divided by sum(|g|-1)
normalization.boundary: Equal constrained-block mean, then mean over required edges within each block
normalization.mib: Within-group logWH variance, groups weighted by |g|-1
normalization.cases: Arithmetic mean across cases, identical for backward and all monitors

removed_reference_dependencies: reference-derived neighbor mask and target relative deltas
reference contact pairs and contact directions
reference bbox or reference optimal area/wirelength as normalization outside position/shape
hard_specs: Public areas, fixed dimensions and preplaced XYWH remain enforced by decoding; nonnegative output retained; soft losses do not guarantee zero overlap
validation_before_freeze: At most five relevant short cases; include containment, point-contact, alternate group topology, label-independence and finite gradients. Training-only magnitude/gradient sanity, no dev/Q coefficient search
fixed_objective_policy: Freeze all formulas/weights before formal training; no stages, ramps, adaptive difficulty weights or alternate selector
